headline: Kyrgyzstan Changes Taxes for Business, Banks, Catering and Developers » Gazeta.kg - News of Kyrgyzstan and Bishkek Today
summary: Kyrgyzstan adopted a large package of amendments to the Tax Code and non-tax revenue legislation. The changes affect foreign companies, the banking sector, catering and developers, and tax audit procedures.
why: Tax code changes alter the cost base and compliance burden for businesses and banks operating in the country.
